# Guild March

> Free, unofficial weekly guild rankings for World of Warcraft: Forever. Add a guild by name and the site scores its members' levels, achievements and honorable kills each week, ranks it in a small, medium or large league by score per active member, and gives it a tier and land on a territory map. In Korean, English and Traditional Chinese.

Information as of 2026-11-24. Guild March is a fan site and isn't affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment. All game data comes from the public Blizzard Battle.net API.

## About

- What it does: weekly scores, league ranks, tiers, badges and a territory map for registered WoW: Forever guilds
- Who it's for: WoW: Forever guilds and players in four regions (Korea, Taiwan, Americas, Europe) on PvP and Normal realms
- Adding a guild: region, ruleset, faction and guild name. No login, free, and you don't have to be the guild master. Scoring starts on the Thursday after registering
- Data update: twice a week, Thursday (the weekly close) and Monday (mid-week standings) at 08:00 Korea time (23:00 UTC the day before), rosters and member profiles are read from the Battle.net API, ranks are worked out again and the site is rebuilt. Characters still logged in show up after they log out
- Weekly reset: a week closes and the next one starts on Thursday at 08:00 Korea time (Wednesday 23:00 UTC), the same moment in every region. Week one started on November 19, 2026 and closes on November 26, 2026
- Score: 1 point per level gained (up to 20 per character a week), 10 for reaching level 60 (once per character), 5 per achievement (no cap) and 1 per 10 honorable kills (up to 10 per character a week). Dungeons and raids don't count yet
- Who counts: members on the guild roster at level 10 or higher when the week starts. Active members are those who log in at least once that week
- Leagues: 5 to 19 active members play in the small league, 20 to 49 in the medium league, 50 or more in the large league. Fewer than 5 isn't ranked that week. A region's PvP and Normal realm guilds share the same leagues
- Rank: within a league, total points divided by active members (score per member), highest first; ties share a rank
- Tiers: when a week closes, each ranked guild gets one of nine tiers from its position in the league, (rank − 0.5) ÷ guilds. Top 5% Overlord, 12% Castellan, 22% Banner Captain, 34% Breaker II, 46% Breaker I, 58% Vanguard II, 70% Vanguard I, 85% Banner Bearer II, every other ranked guild Banner Bearer I. A league winner gets at least Castellan. The cut-offs are a draft
- Badges: first, second and third in the league, top three three weeks running, biggest climb (at least 2 places), first time ranked, and top level, achievement and honor points per member
- Territory map: one per region and ruleset, 1,994 cells in 37 regions. When a week closes, ranked guilds march by their tier to claim and take land; a guild holding more than half of a region is its lord. A season is four weeks, then the map is cleared. The first season closes on December 17, 2026, at 08:00 Korea time
- Guild pages (/{lang}/guild/{region}/{id}/): this week's rank and score breakdown, a short written summary (roster, league position, level spread against the region and ruleset, where the points came from), members by level, the guilds next to it in its league, each member's points, the week-by-week record, and a share card for recruiting posts
- Discord weekly results: a guild can paste a channel webhook on its guild page; after each week closes the site posts that guild's rank, tier and badges to the channel. Up to 5 channels per guild, no pings
- Live strip: the home page and the guild finder show the guilds people opened in the last 24 hours, and how many people are on the site when there are at least 3
- Data reports: studies of WoW: Forever guild characters from the public API (levels, factions, honor kills, achievements, guild sizes), with totals only and no names. A population page with faction split and level spread is rebuilt at each update, with one page per region and realm type (/{lang}/population/{region}-{ruleset}/, such as /en/population/us-pvp/ or /en/population/eu-pvp/)
- Weekly war reports: after each week closes, a report per region with the week's numbers, the top three of each league, top tiers, the faction comparison and the territory changes
- Privacy: no individual login times are shown; data for characters who leave a tracked roster is deleted within 30 days; anyone can ask for a character or guild to be removed. Page views are counted without cookies and without storing IP addresses (a daily, non-reversible hash), kept 35 days

## English

- [Ranks](https://guildmarch.com/en/): this week's guild ranks, last week's champions and how to join
- [Ranks by region](https://guildmarch.com/en/ranks/): ranks, region lords and the faction comparison for each region and ruleset
- [Territory map](https://guildmarch.com/en/map/): the land-grab map for each region and ruleset
- [Find a guild](https://guildmarch.com/en/guilds/): registered guilds by region, ruleset and faction
- [Factions](https://guildmarch.com/en/factions/): Horde vs Alliance among registered guilds
- [Rules](https://guildmarch.com/en/guide/): the full scoring formula, leagues, badges, tiers, data sources and limits
- [Add your guild](https://guildmarch.com/en/register/): register a guild by name
- [Removal request](https://guildmarch.com/en/opt-out/): take a guild or character off the site
- [Q&A](https://guildmarch.com/en/answers/): questions and answers about ranks, scores, leagues and the map
- [Glossary](https://guildmarch.com/en/glossary/): exact meaning and numbers for each term
- [Guild tiers](https://guildmarch.com/en/tiers/): the nine tiers and their cut-offs
- [Badges and titles](https://guildmarch.com/en/badges/): weekly badges and season titles
- [Population](https://guildmarch.com/en/population/): faction split, level spread, honor and activity of registered guilds' characters, updated twice a week
- [Data reports](https://guildmarch.com/en/insights/): studies of WoW: Forever guild characters from public data
- [Weekly war reports](https://guildmarch.com/en/reports/): each closed week per region: top guilds, tiers, factions and territory
- [Past weeks](https://guildmarch.com/en/weeks/): final ranks of every closed week
- [Find a character](https://guildmarch.com/en/characters/): look up a character's guild and what it added this week
- [About](https://guildmarch.com/en/about/): who runs the site, data sources and scoring
- [Contact](https://guildmarch.com/en/contact/): how to reach the operator
- [Privacy](https://guildmarch.com/en/privacy/): what is stored and what isn't
- [Terms](https://guildmarch.com/en/terms/): terms of use

- [주차별 결과](https://guildmarch.com/ko/weeks/): 마감된 모든 주차의 최종 순위
